entries.subject: Placement

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 40.7 +/- 1.9 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, CV Mon: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 40.7 +/- 1.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5375 +/- 208 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 60, Name='CV Mon', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5375 +/- 208 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic).

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,375 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.722 +/- 0.021 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffecdd. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,375 K and log g 1.4 (u1 0.530, u2 0.203): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 1.4 from 2023A&A...678A.195D, the median of its 3 spectra; the 8 published values span log g 1.3 to 2.02, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.7% of the centre brightness.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 3127142323596470144: 4 G-band harmonics of a 5.378766050182399 d period, peak-to-peak 0.545 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.03 of a cycle there.
